known_deviations: This is a protocol-1.5.1 post-unsealing corrected diagnostic, not pristine blind-validation evidence.
The corrected longwave handoff improves Extended RMSE from 2.729 to 2.483 degC and bias from +2.401 to +2.131 degC, but the temperature gate remains rejected.
Attic RMSE passes its 1.5 degC threshold; ground, kitchen, and sleeping airbodies do not.
Four missing outdoor-CO2 rows independently fail the frozen no-missing-input check.
Thermal conservation, no-fallback, and deterministic-repeat checks pass.
